Mailroom sandwich bites.d: Ham, cheddar and pickle on buttered white bread, crusts off, cut in fingers, in wax paper.
Mailroom sandwich bites.note: Employee Cafeteria, lower level, next to the mailroom.

Kansas corn fritters.d: Sweet corn and scallions in an egg batter, dropped by the spoonful and fried golden. Sour cream for dipping.

Pemrose boardroom canapés.d: Warm buckwheat pancakes with sour cream, dill and cracked pepper. By the dozen.
Pemrose boardroom canapés.note: Boardroom catering, order a day ahead.

Executive rib eye.d: Seared in a hot iron pan, basted with butter, garlic and fresh thyme, then sliced.

Kansas farm fried chicken.d: Soaked overnight, rolled in seasoned flour and cooked crisp. Mashed potatoes, pan gravy.

Kansas apple pie.d: Double crust, cinnamon apples and a sugared top, vanilla ice cream.

Martini.d: Stirred with dry vermouth, served up in a frozen glass, twist.
Martini.note: Bar from 5:30 PM for those working late.
